evals.prompt: Fixture: a B2B SaaS product with a two-engineer platform team, six weeks before the quarter ends, and a Now/Next/Later roadmap: Now holds the billing revamp (ends in three weeks) and mobile offline mode; Next holds the audit-log export; Later holds a self-serve admin console. Work read-only: do not edit or create files; no project tracker is connected, so work only from this prompt. Add single sign-on as an initiative. Both engineers are fully committed for the six weeks, so adding the item does not make anything ship faster. Return the updated roadmap.
evals.expected_output: A Now/Next/Later roadmap with a status label per item, SSO placed in Next or Later with an explicit statement that nothing is displaced because both engineers are fully committed for six weeks (or, if SSO moves into Now, what comes off or moves and why), the capacity assumption, Risks and Dependencies, and a Changes This Update section recording SSO as added and whatever shifted. No /roadmap-update usage line and no connector placeholder, and no tracker data invented beyond the prompt.
assertions: Groups items under Now, Next, and Later with a status label per item, and includes a Changes This Update section that records SSO as added and any item that moved.

Places SSO outside Now in Next or Later and states explicitly that nothing is displaced because both engineers are fully committed for six weeks; if instead it places SSO in Now, it names what comes off or moves and why.
Contains no `/roadmap-update` line and no `~~project tracker` placeholder, and invents no tracker data beyond the prompt.
